history.summary: No published source was found documenting a 'Sri Sri Haraparbati Temple' in Berhampur (Brahmapur) or anywhere in Ganjam district. 'Haraparbati' (Hara-Parbati, i.e. Shiva-Parvati) temples are common in coastal Odisha - documented examples include Haraparbati Temple at Pattamundai, at Akhuapada/Bhandari Pokhari, at Rajkanika, at Tirtol (all Jagatsinghapur/Kendrapara side), and at Suliapada (Mayurbhanj), plus the Langaleswar Hara Parbati Temple in Balasore - but none in the Berhampur/Ganjam region, and none of the searches for a Berhampur-linked Haraparbati shrine returned a match. Identity of this row is therefore unconfirmed: it may refer to a small local Shiva-Parvati shrine in or near Berhampur with no web footprint, or it may be a CSV error (verify on the ground or against the CSV source). Do not invent deities, dates, locality or festival details. District (Ganjam) and state (Odisha) are as per CSV; town (Berhampur) is unconfirmed. Media intentionally left empty: no reliable image for an unidentified referent.
